newsitem.title: UK: Hitler painting sells for $3,750 in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Hitler painting sells for $3,750 in Britain.

text.p: A watercolour believed to have been painted by Adolf Hitler and found by a soldier in a bomb-damaged Hamburg apartment in 1945 was sold for 2,500 pounds ($3,750) on Wednesday.
The picture was found recently under a bed in a suitcase, along with Third Reich memorabilia, in the eastern English county of Lincolnshire where it was sold.
Robert Horner, sales manager at the auction house handling the deal, described the painting as "a bit of a slapdash daub".
The painting of a square in Vienna, dated 1911, is signed "A.Hitler" and coincides with a period when he was trying to make a living as an artist in his native Austria.
Hitler committed suicide in his bunker in Berlin in 1945 as allied forces closed in on the German capital to bring World War Two to an end.
